Utilities Reference¶

Import path¶

from phylognn.utils import get_max_meta_time
get_max_meta_time(tree)¶

Traverse an ETE tree and return the maximum meta_time value among nodes that define it. Returns None if no node has meta_time.

Related guide¶

Use this helper when tree metadata imported from optional readers needs a simple maximum-time summary before feature engineering.
